STAGE 1 — goal: read the four frozen evidence bundles and fix the discriminating facts before ranking.
READ: all four bundles (succframe-warp-rq 884de26c, beh-aniso-poincare-rq d2b8dee1, STATECELL-MARGIN-RQ a92403e8, SUCCFRAME-MOEB-RQ 96334c90). The OBSERVED items are identical across bundles; only the PROPOSED items differ.
KEY OBSERVATIONS (same in every bundle):
- E6 (width-20 beam survival, 57,439 test rows): l1_br recall@10 0.04671 (gold prefix alive depth1/2/3/4 = 1.000/1.000/1.000/0.068); l1_br_euclid 0.06207 (1.000/0.829/0.161/0.085); l1_only 0.06233; resample 0.06363 (0.497/0.122/0.091/0.088); successor_entropy 0.05122; successor_geodesic_coarse 0.05500; successor_geodesic_coarse_v2 0.05463; tangent_successor_residual 0.05500. So (a) no arm yet clears the 0.065 target, the best is 0.06363; (b) the recall loss is at prefix depth 3/4 (0.16/0.09 survival) not depth 1; (c) every curve-heavy/behaviour-forced arm sits BELOW its Euclidean counterpart — hyperbolic-forced level 1 (l1_br) is the worst arm at 0.04671 while its Euclidean twin is 0.06207.
- E7 teacher-forced NLL: l1_br 0/0/0/9.03, l1_br_euclid 0/3.22/4.36/1.23, resample 4.55/3.82/0.73/0.05 — confirms the deepest position is where SIDs break.
- E5 successor entropy: top-1 mass 0.4375 in the low-entropy quintile but only 2.72 distinct successors on average (bin1 support 2.77), 0.0543 top-1 in the top quintile with 41 distinct — the transition graph is thin for most items.
- E8 level-1 capacity ceiling at K=256: only 0.0822 of behaviour pairs share a level-1 cluster (0.0129 negatives); at K=64 it is 0.1547 — successor co-location is a small absolute effect and content already captures most of it.
- E11 same_first_prefix_rate 0.0907 against permuted null 0.067 — the behaviour→prefix signal in existing SIDs is a ~2.4 point absolute effect.
- E10 sparse transition table: 115,582 distinct edges, mean out-degree 5.45.
OPEN: convert these into a single ordering.

STAGE 2 — goal: place each proposal against the two binding facts (E6: curved arms underperform Euclidean; E6/E7: failure is at depth 3/4, not depth 1) and against scope/experiment policy (one run, no sweep, no ablation, derived constants).
- STATECELL-MARGIN-RQ: behaviour = popularity-adjusted successor profile p_ij = c_ij/sqrt(1+c_j) (directly answers the E5 skew and the E8 hot-cell ceiling); geometry = Poincare geodesic squared distance with c derived from the 99th-percentile encoder norm (derived, not swept); coupling = single argmin of d2_ik + tau_l*(clip(log q/log(1/K),0,1)-1), so removing either term changes the code chosen at every level; and the successor-code distribution targets exactly the depth-2..4 prefix chain E6/E7 show collapsing. Crucially the margin is capped at tau_l = median nearest-code squared distance, so behaviour cannot override content by more than one typical quantization unit — that is the guard against repeating the l1_br failure (0.04671). Switches: beta=0, Euclidean, both-on, all in code. Falsifier is stated (prefix-match rate flat + recall at baseline). Best available: attacks the measured bottleneck with bounded risk and fully derived constants.
- succframe-warp-rq: strong coupling (determinant-one per-item warp W_i from the successor second moment enters the nearest-code rule at all levels, so removing either changes assignment); tail fallback B_i=I,s_i=1 for |S_i|<2 matches E5's thin graph. But it replaces the Euclidean residual metric with a warped artanh metric at every level, exactly the class E6 shows losing to Euclidean (l1_br 0.04671, successor_geodesic_coarse 0.05500 vs l1_br_euclid/l1_only 0.06207/0.06233); stretch clipped to [1/sqrt d, sqrt d] ≈ [0.18, 5.7] at d=32 gives a ~32x range and a real artanh-explosion risk; per-epoch frame refresh makes the metric non-stationary against a shared codebook. Second.
- SUCCFRAME-MOEB-RQ: changes the residual PATH by Mobius isometries and replaces the reconstruction loss with a geodesic loss — the loss swap confounds attribution in a single run (its own risk list says so), the frozen rank-d SVD anchor is popularity-dominated on a graph with 5.45 mean out-degree (E10) and <2 successors for most items (E5) so it degenerates to plain curved RQ precisely where E6 shows curvature losing, and rho=0.5 / tau=0.5493 are documented-but-chosen constants. Third.
- beh-aniso-poincare-rq: real coupling (gauge in the same closed-form distance as assignment and in the Fréchet codebook update) but the stretch is bounded by beta in [0,1] so the cost ratio is at most sqrt(2) ≈ 1.41 — against E11's 0.0907-vs-0.067 prefix signal and E8's 0.0822 co-location ceiling that is close to a no-op; and replacing baseline codebook dynamics with tangent Fréchet means abandons the update rule that produced the 0.0621-0.0636 Euclidean arms. Fourth.
OPEN: emit final ranking block.

STAGE 3 — FINAL ANSWER (complete ranking and objection, stands on its own).

{"ranking": [
 {"idea_id": "STATECELL-MARGIN-RQ", "position": 1, "reason": "Only proposal that attacks the measured bottleneck and bounds its own risk: E6/E7 show the gold prefix survives depth 1/2 at 1.000/0.829 but collapses at depth 3/4 (0.161/0.085), so the loss is in the deeper prefix chain, and its capped successor-code margin acts at all three levels; tau_l = median nearest-code squared distance caps behaviour at one typical quantization unit, which is the guard the worst arm l1_br (recall@10 0.04671) lacked; popularity-adjusted p_ij = c_ij/sqrt(1+c_j) answers the E5 top-1-mass skew (0.4375 low-entropy vs 0.0543 high) and the E8 K=256 co-location ceiling 0.0822 (negatives 0.0129); curvature c is derived from the 99th-percentile encoder norm and tau from the data, so no constant is swept, and the three switches plus the 'prefix-match flat => drop' falsifier make a single run decisive."},
 {"idea_id": "succframe-warp-rq", "position": 2, "reason": "Genuine one-pathway coupling - the determinant-one successor-frame warp W_i sits in the nearest-code rule and the level loss at every level, so removing behaviour (B_i=I, s_i=1) or geometry changes the assignment - and it degrades gracefully to identity for the many items with fewer than two successors that E5 documents (support 2.77 in the lowest-entropy bin) while adding no new loss constant; but it is a full replacement of the Euclidean residual metric by a warped artanh distance at every level, the exact class E6 shows losing to Euclidean (l1_br 0.04671 and successor_geodesic_coarse 0.05500 against l1_br_euclid 0.06207 and l1_only 0.06233), its stretch clip [1/sqrt d, sqrt d] spans ~32x at d=32 with a real artanh-gradient blow-up risk, and the once-per-epoch frame refresh makes the metric non-stationary against a shared codebook."},
 {"idea_id": "SUCCFRAME-MOEB-RQ", "position": 3, "reason": "Real Mobius coupling (the residual recursion p_l = (p_{l-1} (-) C_l[k_l]) (+) A_l(i) and its exact inverse decode cannot be split into behaviour and geometry), but it also SWAPS the baseline reconstruction loss for a geodesic loss, so any recall change is confounded between frame and loss and one run cannot separate them - its own risk list concedes this; the frozen rank-d SVD anchor is popularity-driven on a graph E10 puts at 5.45 mean out-degree, and E5 shows most items have under two successors, so it degenerates to plain curved RQ exactly where E6 measures curvature losing (successor_geodesic_coarse 0.05500 vs resample 0.06363); rho=0.5 and tau=0.5493 are chosen geometric defaults, not measured quantities."},
 {"idea_id": "beh-aniso-poincare-rq", "position": 4, "reason": "The coupling is structurally correct (the gauge enters the same distance used for assignment and for the tangent Frechet codebook update, with beta=0 / c->0 / both-on switches), but the effect is designed to be tiny: beta in [0,1] bounds the along-successor stretch at sqrt(2), a worst-case cost ratio of 1.41, which against E11's same-first-prefix 0.0907 vs permuted null 0.067 and E8's 0.0822 level-1 co-location ceiling at K=256 is close to a no-op; it also replaces the baseline codebook update with tangent Frechet means, discarding the update dynamics under which the Euclidean arms reached 0.06207/0.06233, and its own risk list leads with 'anisotropy may be too mild'."}
], "objection": "All four rank above nothing on the strength of the same weak sig

nal: the OBSERVED evidence caps the behaviour-to-prefix effect at 0.0907 same-first-prefix against a 0.067 permuted null (E11) and 0.0822 behaviour-pair co-location at K=256 against 0.0129 negatives (E8), while the transition graph is thin (115,582 edges, mean out-degree 5.45, 2.72 distinct successors in the low-entropy bin - E10/E5) and no arm in E6 clears the 0.065 target, the best being the non-hyperbolic resample at 0.06363. Because every candidate here makes a curved distance the assignment metric, and every curved arm in E6 sits below its Euclidean twin (l1_br 0.04671 vs l1_br_euclid 0.06207; successor_geodesic_coarse 0.05500 vs l1_only 0.06233), the first-placed proposal carries genuine, non-ablatable risk that the geometry term costs the 0.0014-0.005 that separates the best observed arm from the target, and with one run, no sweep and no seed repetition that risk cannot be resolved before the round is decided."}

STEP 1 — goal: scope-check all four proposals against the five scope clauses and the experiment policy before ranking.
Read: the four idea blocks (succframe-warp-rq, beh-aniso-poincare-rq, STATECELL-MARGIN-RQ, SUCCFRAME-MOEB-RQ) and the four frozen evidence bundles (b446d876c2868ce3, e73b8eb1c7c940d1, 3f0b0e98e5eaa49d, 7c4d9919976eaa7c) — identical OBSERVED blocks E4-E11 in each, PROPOSED blocks differ per idea.
Observed: all four name a training-only directed-transition signal built from train split only (E1-E3 in each bundle), all four name an explicit curved operation (Poincare ball, Mobius add/sub, exp/log maps, artanh distance) acting inside the Stage-2 RQ assignment/recursion (E12-E14), all four put behaviour and geometry on one pathway (warped distance / anisotropic gauge / additive geodesic margin / Mobius anchor recursion) with behaviour-off, geometry-off and both-on switches present but no arm trained, and all four derive their constants (c=1 fixed, alpha_i from eigenvalue share, 99th-percentile norm curvature + median tau_l, tau=atanh(0.5), rho=0.5) rather than sweeping. Reason: none is out of scope, so the ranking has to be settled on evidence-grounded expected effect and risk, not on admission.
Open: which evidence lines discriminate between them.

STEP 2 — goal: extract the discriminating numbers from the shared OBSERVED evidence and apply them to the four candidates.
Read: E5 (successor-entropy stratification: top-1 mass 0.4375 in bin 1 vs 0.0543 in bin 5, Spearman -0.9733, 4895 items in the lowest-entropy bin), E6 (width-20 beam survival: l1_br 0.04671 with gold prefix alive 1.000/1.000/1.000/0.068; l1_br_euclid 0.06207; l1_only 0.06233; resample 0.06363; successor_entropy 0.05122; successor_geodesic_coarse 0.05500; v2 0.05463; tangent_successor_residual 0.05500), E7 (l1_br T1/T2/T3/T4 NLL 0.00/0.00/0.00/9.03 = prefix collapse), E8 (K=256 behavioural-neighbour cluster share 0.0822 vs negative 0.0129), E9 and E11 (same_first_prefix_rate 0.0907 vs permuted null 0.067), E10 (mean outgoing degree 5.45, 115582 distinct edges).
Reasoning: (a) every observed behaviour-plus-hyperbolic variant in E6 sits at 0.051-0.055, i.e. below the Euclidean-adjacent controls (0.06207/0.06233) and well under the 0.065 target, so heavy curved machinery has a documented negative track record here and risk-of-damage must weigh more than novelty; (b) E6/E7 show the specific failure of a curved level-1 that collapses (all NLL on T4, prefix alive 1.000 at depths 1-3); (c) E11 (0.0907 vs 0.067) and E8 (0.0822 at K=256) say the available level-1 co-location headroom is small, so a bounded, capped behaviour influence is better matched to the data than a full metric re-warp; (d) E5's strong concentration supports deriving per-item anisotropy from successor mass but also warns it will be near-maximal for the 4895 lowest-entropy items; (e) E10's mean out-degree 5.45 and the tail sparsity make frozen row-normalised SVD anchors popularity-driven where SIDs are least used.
Open: convert this into the ordering.

STEP 3 — FINAL ANSWER (complete, stands alone).

Ranking decided: STATECELL-MARGIN-RQ 1st (bounded, one-quantization-unit margin on a geodesic cost, constants derived from data: c from the 99th-percentile encoder norm, tau_l = median nearest-code squared distance; matches the small measured headroom E11 0.0907 vs null 0.067 and E8 0.0822 at K=256, and its cap is the safeguard against the E6/E7 collapse pattern l1_br 0.04671 with T1-T3 NLL 0.00/0.00/0.00). SUCCFRAME-MOEB-RQ 2nd (exact Mobius-isometry recursion so the anchor is distance-preserving and reconstruction stays exact-inverse; lowest cost 1.02-1.10x; frozen anchors avoid per-epoch non-stationarity; but the geodesic reconstruction loss swap confounds attribution and E6 l1_br vs l1_br_euclid 0.04671 vs 0.06207 shows the curved-loss route has hurt; row-normalised SVD anchor is popularity-driven per E5 top-1 mass 0.4375 and E10 degree 5.45). succframe-warp-rq 3rd (highest capacity and the only true metric warp, but per-epoch refresh, eigenvalue clip ratio up to d=32 giving [0.177,5.66], the loss itself becomes the warped distance, and E5 alpha_i ~ maximal for the 4895 low-entropy items; the closest prior curved behaviour variants in E6 landed 0.05500/0.05463/0.05500, below Euclidean controls 0.06207/0.06233). beh-aniso-poincare-rq 4th (stretch capped at sqrt(2) with beta_i -> 0 for tail items, so reach is bounded below the 0.065 gap implied by E6; it also silently replaces the codebook update with a tangent Frechet mean, an untested second change, its c->0 geometry-off flat limit is not a clean switch, and its beta_i / uhat_l transport is the least determinate specification of the four).
